answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 8747 Country: Canada Title: Is it permissible to use soap to wash one's body? If not, why? If not, what can I use to ensure that my body is clean other than water? Question: Is it permissible to use soap to wash one's body? If not, why? If not, what can I use to ensure that my body is clean other than water? Answer ID: 8747 Posted on: Aug 29, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 2142/1738=B/1429) Yes, it is allowed to wash body with soap. Having applied soap, if the body is washed clean with water it will become tahir (pure and clean). Do not get in any doubt. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
